chapter: Later tours, illness and the union job
title: How the hernia operation affected his playing
summary: He says hernia pain shows up a day later, like carrying too many groceries.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: What, now you're talking of chops, what affect does the hernia operation have on sort of blowing? Are you conscious of anything in your sort of intestines when you blow?
No, right now I'm not, but you might feel it's not right. You feel it the next morning.
Yes. You don't feel it right then. I don't, I didn't.
Does it seem like a stretching?

No, just a little pain there. I know I also can get it, I used to get it when I tried to bring home too many groceries in the shopping bag. I'd bring the groceries home on a Monday and I'd feel it on a Wednesday. And I'd know right away what why I felt it. It's not a big pain but it's just enough to let you know, you shouldn't have brought those, all those groceries.
Isn't that amazing though really? Yes, yes.
I would bring big cans of dog food. Sometimes I'd have two shopping bags and I know they were heavy but I didn't think.......
You thought you were taking the weight on your arms?

I didn't feel it while I'm bringing them home. You see it doesn't come until later. I'd bring them home, take them upstairs, set them down, feel okay but a day or two later you feel it. So that's just to let you know you're not quite ready to ......
